packageRules.description: Merge non-major updates once every CI check on the pull request passes
Toolchains and Node type definitions follow runtime targets and are reviewed by hand
The VS Code API floor is the minimum supported editor and is raised deliberately
npm comes from the integrity pin in tools/npm-bootstrap.json, which changes together with packageManager
Locally patched replacements are re-vendored together with their patch records
Vendored upstream sources and pinned offline oracle inputs are not dependency manifests
